How to use this chart

  • Number of vacant stalls reflect visitor stalls only.
  • Accessible (disabled) and motorcycle stalls are not included in the count of vacant stalls. Which locations have these stalls?
  • Vacant stall counts are most accurate during each lot’s hours of control. Please see the lot locations and hours page for details.
